title: Agentic AI: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Applications, and Future Directions
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey of Agentic AI. While it includes a dedicated section on ethical and governance challenges (Section 7) and a corresponding table mapping these challenges (Table 9), its primary contribution is the categorization and synthesis of existing research across foundations, architectures, and applications. It does not perform an original evaluation or benchmark of religion, morals, or ethics, but rather surveys the state of the field regarding these issues.
